name: A street market: the player walks the cobbled lane between stall rows

designStructure.title: Static on the Night Shift
designStructure.premise: A volunteer community radio station keeps its overnight request show running as the outbreak reaches the transmitter block.
designStructure.opening: The last caller asked for a song nobody could find. Keep the signal up until the helicopter comes.

rooms.title: Station Lobby
rooms.description: Front desk with the request line, signed photos of every presenter on the wall.

rooms.title: Green Room
rooms.description: Where guests waited for their slot; the kettle and the guest book are still out.

rooms.title: Newsroom
rooms.description: Desks split by acoustic panels where the local bulletin was cut.

rooms.title: Record Library
rooms.description: Floor-to-ceiling vinyl, hand-lettered genre cards and the reel archive.

rooms.title: Studio B
rooms.description: A round mic table for the call-in hour, chairs pulled back mid-segment.

rooms.title: Control Room One
rooms.description: The board op's desk faces the studio glass; the overnight playlist is still taped to the rack.
